species.name: Gwyllgi

evolves.flag_text: once you have passed a Welsh lesson

dex.text: A dark dog that keeps to the lanes after dusk. Walks beside you until you realise it is not walking with you at all.
dex.fact: Gwyllgi roughly means 'dusk dog' in Welsh, and it belongs to a wider family of black dogs in British folklore.

species.real: Black dog legends are so common across Britain that 'the black dog' became a byword for depression, most famously used by Winston Churchill.

species.name: Annwnhound

dex.text: The dusk dog has finally stopped pretending to be a dog. White coat, red ears, and a howl you hear a valley away before you see anything at all.
dex.fact: In Welsh tradition the Cŵn Annwn are the hounds of Annwn, the Otherworld, said to be white with red ears.

species.real: Some Welsh tellings explain the Cŵn Annwn's baying overhead at night as wild geese on migration, which is a very reasonable way to spoil a good ghost story.
